idea-plugin.name: Darkmoon
idea-plugin.description:
Darkmoon brings your AI-driven penetration-test campaigns into the IDE. Browse campaigns and findings, read redaction-safe reports, and launch a new campaign — against both Darkmoon OSS (local CLI) and Darkmoon Pro (REST API), with Pro-only capabilities cleanly disabled on OSS.

  • Campaigns and a sortable, filterable, searchable Vulnerabilities table.
  • Finding detail: description, evidence (redacted by default) and remediation.
  • Reports that are redaction-safe by default; the full rehydrated report is opened only on an explicit, local, two-key action.

Secrets are stored in the IDE's PasswordSafe, never in plugin settings or logs.



Darkmoon is open-source — a star really helps.
⭐ Star the core: github.com/ASCIT31/Dark-Moon
🌐 Website: dark-moon.org · 📚 Docs: docs.dark-moon.org
Also on: VS Code, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and npm.
